lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in vertical and horizontal rows. A group of three bright spots in the upper-center quadrant forms a distinct triangular formation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of blobs, creating a nodal grid pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity lighting on the upper edge to a deep shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin features a high-density, heterogeneous distribution of smaller circular spots that differ in size and spacing from the primary flank constellation.
